1385-3220-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1385-3220-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat, Golgari Germination and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Golgari Germination ability, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
5107-5261-5475.description:

Resolve Rally of Wings, untapping all creatures you control and giving creatures you control that have flying +2/+2 until end of turn
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

4289-4460-4770-5301.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1339-2999-8192.description:

The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to pay 1 life to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2445-5147-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
2445-5147-5254.description:

When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat.

6495-6972-7607.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3504-3734.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3504-3734.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Mercurial Pretender and Phyrexian Metamorph each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mercurial Pretender trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3504-3734.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

465-719-3742-4251-5434.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Possessed Skaab
When the Possessed Skaab token enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Holding priority, activate Echo Mage by tapping it, copying Awaken the Maelstrom twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Awaken the Maelstrom spells, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

1018-1987-4276-4823.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Skullwinder and Timeless Witness.
